_comment: Round 4 = round 3 + (a) price_period, a categorical key for the three price-list revisions read off the residuals (2023-04-01, 2024-07-01, 2025-04-01), so that any table can take per-period values, (b) eight search variants (the four defaults plus forward-initialised and no-plain-first combinations) to reduce the path dependence seen in rounds 2-3. The engine keeps a term only if more quotes reproduce to the yen.

derived.tax_label: if_(isblank(tax_label), if_(regex(customer_code, '^(一般|K)', 1, '') != '', '税込', if_(regex(customer_code, '^([CD])[0-9]', 1, '') != '', '税抜', '')), tax_label)
derived.a4eq: if_(product == '名刺' or product == '封筒', 0, quantity * kinds * if_(size == 'A3', 2, if_(size == 'B4', 1.5, if_(size == 'B5', 0.75, if_(size == 'A5', 0.5, 1)))))
derived.sheets: if_(product == 'チラシ' or product == 'リーフレット', ceil(quantity / if_(size == 'A3', 4, if_(size == 'A4', 8, if_(size == 'B4', 8, 16)))) * kinds, 0)
